witness.recorder: the replies read back off the Reflector's own socket by a raw Darwin.socket/connect client and decoded with JSONSerialization — never the target's Frame reader or its JSONValue decoder — carrying values AppKit computed rather than values the test wrote: a constraint-solved frame, a labelColor resolved against the window's effective appearance, and a CoreAnimation layer model. Plus the socket file's own mode, read off the inode.

armedBy: Sabotage run in the same test body: ProctorReflector.stop() closes the listening descriptor and unlinks the path, and the same client over the same window then fails connect with errno 2 on all three ops. The armed variant removed the stop() call and the sabotage half went red with four issues — the socket still existed, stillAnswered read 3, no refusal was a connect failure, and isRunning was still true.
